evidence: 'Operating Model + DCF'!C90 (Tax Rate, 2025) is hardcoded -0.3, while D90:H90 are 0.3. NOPAT C91 '=C89*(1-C90)' therefore becomes EBIT*1.3 = -130.392*1.3 = -169.51 in the GT, not -91.27.
